hill_estimator.interpretation: Hill alpha < 2 = infinite-variance tail; alpha 2-4 = heavy tail; alpha > 4 = moderate.

evt_gpd.interpretation: xi>0 → heavy tail. xi>0.5 → very heavy (CVaR explodes). xi<0 → bounded tail.
